title: Boats to Save People
summary: Find the fewest boats needed to carry everyone.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–50000 people. 1 ≤ people[i] ≤ limit ≤ 30000. Return an integer boat count.
contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned int.

statement: Find the fewest boats needed to carry everyone. A boat carries at most two people and their combined weight cannot exceed limit. Every person can fit alone.
constraints: 1–50000 people. 1 ≤ people[i] ≤ limit ≤ 30000. Return an integer boat count.
hints: Conceptual: The heaviest remaining person must leave on some boat.
Directional: Try pairing that person with the lightest remaining person.
Implementation: After sorting, use two endpoints. Always consume the heavier endpoint and consume the lighter endpoint only when the pair fits.
complexityAnalysis: O(n log n) time and O(n) auxiliary sorting storage for the internal reference.
